title: Heat-resistant crops: a hybrid photosynthesis enzyme
summary: At Michigan State University, AlphaFold predicted the 3D structure of glycerate kinase in a crop and a heat-loving alga. Replacing three flexible loops with rigid loops from the alga produced a hybrid that remained stable up to 65 °C. The enzyme has not yet been tested in whole plants.
organization: Google DeepMind; and Michigan State University

evidence.tested: Hybrid glycerate kinase enzymes with three loops replaced by rigid loops from a heat-loving alga were tested in the lab, and one stayed stable up to 65 °C; whole-plant testing has not been done.
evidence.unknown: It is not yet known whether the hybrid enzyme improves heat resilience in a whole plant; the page does not say whether the AlphaFold-predicted structures were experimentally validated.
evidence.ai_role: AlphaFold predicted the enzyme's 3D structures, which were then used in molecular simulations to identify loops to modify.
